hooks.name: Session handoff
hooks.description: When the session stops, update PROGRESS.md and tasks.md and commit

action.prompt: Run the handoff from .kiro/steering/workflow.md: update PROGRESS.md (Done / In progress / Next step / Blocked / Decisions), tick finished tasks in .kiro/specs/agent-watch/tasks.md, add interview questions for completed tasks to docs/INTERVIEW_PREP.md, then commit with message 'chore: session handoff'. Print a 5-line summary for the next session.
